_help: Hand-maintained classification of the frontend calls that openapi.json does not have (scripts/contract-gaps.mjs reads it).
Key: "METHOD /v1/path" with every variable part as {} (the scan prints the keys; run `node scripts/contract-gaps.mjs --check`).
Value: { app: mobile | console | mobile+console, class, owner, pr?, milestone?, fix?, note? }.

class: pending-pr (an open or stacked PR builds it) | fix-frontend (the frontend changes) | fix-backend (the backend lacks it and no spec says when: a frontend proposal or an unspecified view; spec it, build it or drop it) | later (a spec exists, a milestone builds it) | drop (mocked by decision, no real endpoint).
owner: yash (frontend) | prathamesh (backend). Milestones: MS-A 13 Dec 2026, MS-B 24 Jan, MS-C 21 Feb, MS-D 7 Mar (handbook 14); a module's sprint is in its spec header.
Delete an entry when its fix lands (--check reports a stale entry). extra_fixes lists mismatches the scan cannot see.

GET /v1/public/cooks/{}.fix: Use GET /v1/partners/{id}/card (M8 owns know-your-cook). It needs sign-in; decide whether the QR page stays public.
GET /v1/public/cooks/{}.note: M12 §3.7: public cook profiles are M8's card.

POST /v1/mandates.note: UPI Autopay is not in this phase; M5 §3.7 keeps /v1/mandates out of openapi.json. Done: hidden behind VITE_FEATURE_AUTOPAY (off by default); with it off the app makes no mandate call. The pilot switches the flag on.

extra_fixes.fix: Done (checked against frontend/mobile on 2 Nov 2026): the mock role grants take their scope ids from `mocks/packer.js` (HUB_ID, SOCIETY_ID: the seed UUIDs), and `kitchen.js` and `community.js` use them too; no slug scope_id is left. Was: Mock role grants use slug scope_ids; use the seed UUIDs (hub 0199a000-0000-7000-8000-00000000a001, Sunrise Towers ...b001) so the same code runs on both.

Done (checked against frontend/console on 2 Nov 2026): the today board calls GET /v1/analytics/hubs/{id}/today, Customers calls GET /v1/analytics/societies and /kpis, and KPIs calls GET /v1/analytics/kpis with `data_source`; none calls ops-board or customer-summary. Was: M12 §3.3 ships (GET /v1/analytics/hubs/{id}/today, /kpis, /societies) and replaces the mocks. GET /v1/hubs/{id}/ops-board becomes /v1/analytics/hubs/{id}/today: timestamps and HH:MM, formatted by the console; compose the status line from steps; no markers or route; attention is { kind, count, oldest_at, due_at, link } (copy and tone from kind; issues link to /hub/issues). GET /v1/analytics/customer-summary becomes /v1/analytics/societies (the console totals items and counts status unlocking as joining; paused_households is in the row). /kpis needs data_source real|synthetic, returns periods (ISO dates) and series.<key>.

Done (checked against frontend/console on 2 Nov 2026): `catalog_editor` is in STAFF_ROLES, ROLES (home /catalog, Rekha Joshi, sections [catalog]) and the nav, and the sign-in page lists every ROLES entry. Was: Add the catalog_editor role (seed person Rekha Joshi, +91 98000 01013): its home, nav sections (catalog and prices) and the sign-in button.

Done (checked against frontend/console on 2 Nov 2026): lib/hub.js documents GET /v1/hubs as shipped and the mocks README gives the real-mode ports 8000 and 3000. Was: GET /v1/hubs ships now: update the comments that say it is a 404, and the mocks README (it says API port 8010 and console port 3160; real mode is 8000 and 3000, see docs/SETUP.md 'Real mode').

Done (checked against frontend/console on 2 Nov 2026): POST /v1/admin/ngos (name, kind, hub_ids, accepts, registration_ref, note), GET and POST /v1/ngo-handoffs with Idempotency-Key and photo_keys, GET /v1/ngo-handoffs/ready and the handoff confirm are called with the M9 section 3.5 shapes. The console makes no PATCH /v1/admin/ngos call, so the If-Match part has nothing to check; a drive is created with `ngo_id: null`, which the spec allows. Was: M9 §3.5 ships: build against its shapes, not the mock's (M9 §3.5 'Mock today'). POST /v1/admin/ngos takes { name, kind, hub_ids, accepts, registration_ref, verified, status, note } (coordinators are M1 role grants) and PATCH needs If-Match; GET /v1/ngo-handoffs is Page[Handoff] with `report` (`summary` is structured; `open_batches` is GET /v1/ngo-handoffs/ready); POST /v1/ngo-handoffs takes { ngo_id, hub_id, kind, donation_ids | offer_ids | meals, photo_keys (1 to 3 handoff_photo uploads), people_reached, handed_at, note } with an Idempotency-Key; a drive's ngo_id may be set.
